public_comment.speaker: Pete Lincoln
public_comment.topic: Tribute to Elsa Watson and the importance of relationships
public_comment.quote: he spoke of a personal relationship with his own grandmother and proceeded to pay tribute to elsa watson, who worked at the lunenburg adult activity centerfor many years in the kitchen and the positive effect she had on all those who knew her.

topics.quote: due to other obligations senator cronin and rep. scarsdale were unable to attend but will be rescheduled.
welcome to brandie o'toole, the new meal site manager. there is an open position for an outreach coordinator and a per diem van driver.
financial report: none at this time.
two upcoming programs include: be a better listener on feb. 10 at 11:30 lunch included and we care 365 on february 25 at 9:00 am breakfast included.
lou franco will be meeting with selectboard chair, caesar nuzzolo, to discuss.
last report has the completion date for the umass groton er facility as late 2026
furnishings have been chosen. the hold-up is waiting to make sure funding is in place.
there will be a bulletin board at the center with information regarding 41a and other potential tax breaks for seniors.
chairperson deb lincoln asked board members to submit content for the page if they come across any information, etc. of interest.

selectboard chair, caesar nuzzolo informed the board that the current by- laws are outdated going back to when council on aging's were first introduced. the by-law committee will be meeting. it may be easier to start from scratch

director debra goodsell presented her report of upcoming programs and events including be a better listener, eat well, feel well: a vegan wellness workshop, new additional balance class has been added to the schedule, and an additional stronger senlors exercise program on wednesdays, february heart health month, np lauren parilla will present and educational program on taking care of your heart as we age.

vice president of the eagle house supporters, barbara coulombe presented a list of all the upcoming trips that the group is sponsoring and also noted that there are two upcoming fundraisers belng promoted, a gift card frenzy bingo and a pickleball tournament.

chairperson deb lincoln suggested that the coa board take its own minutes. it was suggested that board members take turns monthly. it was also suggested that the board look into al options. the board will reconvene with more information at the next meeting.
